@@ output/template/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md ;; Agent (subagent delegating to code-review).
@scope agent code-reviewer (delegated review)
1-6 IM ;; Frontmatter (name, routing description).
7 OL [wf010.agent-disallowed]
8-10 IM ;; Preloaded code-review skill; frontmatter delimiter.
12 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, capability, loading metadata).
14 NN ;; Heading.
16 OL [wf010.agent-procedure]

C wf010.agent-disallowed OL WF-010 ENFORCED ;; The code-reviewer agent disallows Write, Edit and NotebookEdit. ;; = ;; MultiEdit and shell tools are not disallowed. ;;
C wf010.agent-procedure OL WF-010 MUST ;; Run the code-review workflow on the requested scope and return its report; do not edit files or redefine review criteria (the workflow and the standards it loads are authoritative). ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.cap-slot-architecture EX ARC-001,ARC-020 MUST ;; The architecture slot is a required frame with exactly one implementation that binds no slot and defines the stable role vocabulary; placement belongs to the frame and technique to the leaves; an implementation must provide role map, dependency direction, domain modeling, use-case orchestration, commit-boundary placement, composition root, transport contracts, test-project placement, not-adopted styles, scaffold layout and a deterministic reference check. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability contract not in the oracle.
C x.cap-facet-roles EX - MUST ;; Every implementation provides exactly the slot contract's role-named facet locations (DEC selection row, STD, KNW named in the register, WF, ENF); file names never change with the implementation; module manifests list their facets and contract coverage. ;; = ;; none ;; Facet-role convention not in the oracle.

C x.cap-slot-persistence EX DEP-009,ARC-019 MUST ;; The persistence slot is a required leaf with exactly one implementation and one provider variant, bound to the architecture frame; an implementation must provide technology boundary, commit-boundary binding, migration mechanism, seeding mechanism, provider variant, declared properties (e.g. string comparison), testing implications, change workflow, knowledge and enforcement. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability contract not in the oracle.
C x.cap-persistence-replacement EX ARC-020,GOV-017 MUST ;; A provider change is a variant change inside the persistence slot; replacing the implementation requires every contract item, and an item the proposal cannot provide (e.g. a migration mechanism) is surfaced as Blocked in the Decision Request instead of being dropped. ;; = ;; Persistence implementation or provider changes. ;; Replacement procedure not in the oracle.
